part2.question: Describe a place where you don't like the music they play

segments.v: I want to talk about a milk tea shop near my school. I go there with my friends two or three times a week after school. The drinks are cheap and it is cool inside. But I don't like the music there. They always play remix songs. The music is very loud and the bass is very strong. They play the same songs every time. I don't like it because we cannot talk to each other. We have to shout. I also cannot do homework there because it is too noisy. I think remix songs are not as good as the original songs. I think the shop plays loud music to make the atmosphere exciting. I hope they will play quieter music in the future.

I'd like to talk about a milk tea shop near my school, where I really don't like the music they play. It's part of a popular chain, on the main road just outside our school gate, so after class it's always full of students.
